facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services publishes the final Zimbabwe National AI Strategy 2026-2030, introduced by the President, refined from the Kadoma Draft after consultations in Harare, Bulawayo and Masvingo in August-September 2025; the document carries no date of its own, so as_of is its published date.
